generation.invocation_policy: Every final card image was created with its own separate built-in ImageGen call. No CLI, multi-image n parameter, source artwork, or reference image was used.
generation.originality: Original compositions only; no imitation of Ark Nova or any other board-game artwork.
generation.style: Contemporary cut-paper collage mixed with matte gouache, bold rounded geometric shapes, subtle handmade paper grain, and clean layered edges.
generation.composition: 16:9 landscape, one clear focal subject, important content inside the central 80%, thumbnail-readable.
generation.palette: Forest green, muted coral, ochre, cream, teal, with restrained dark accents.
generation.global_constraints: No text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, emblems, badges, patches, watermark, card border, card frame, UI, icons, labels, recognizable celebrities, copied poses, or pre-existing tabletop-game composition.
generation.production_output: Each accepted source was converted to 512x288 RGB WebP, quality 84, filename equal to card ID.

prompt_template:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original browser board-game card illustration, sponsor card {id}
Primary request: {name_en}; depict {scene}.
Scene/backdrop: {backdrop}
Style/medium: entirely original contemporary cut-paper collage mixed with matte gouache; bold rounded geometric shapes; subtle handmade paper grain; clean layered edges; visual identity distinct from all existing board games.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape; one clear focal subject; important subject matter inside the central 80%; medium-wide crop; safe for center-cropping and small card display.
Lighting/mood: warm, optimistic natural light; thoughtful conservation mood.
Color palette: forest green, muted coral, ochre, cream, teal, with restrained dark accents.
Constraints: create a new original composition from scratch; no reference images; no recognizable celebrity; no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, card border, card frame, UI, icons, labels, or copied poses.
Avoid: imitating Ark Nova or any other board-game artwork; existing tabletop-game composition; photorealism; clutter; tiny disconnected details.
